_backends: Two servers, because OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE is read once at server start and has no per-request override. Every other setting that matters (num_ctx, num_predict, temperature) can be set per request, so it needs no server of its own.
_default: f16 is the safe default: q8_0 quantises KV in blocks of 32, which must divide the model's V head dimension. kimi-linear has n_embd_head_v=72 and cannot ever load on q8_0, so unknown models have to land here.
_routes: Longest matching prefix wins, so 'gemma4' covers 'gemma4:12b'. q8_0 only pays off for models that are VRAM-bound. Measured on a 10GB RTX 3080 at ctx 16384, num_parallel 1 (eval tok/s): gemma4 53.9 -> 62.9 on q8; qwen3-coder 29.6 -> 31.0 on q8. Models that already fit entirely are SLOWER on q8_0 (qwen3.5 98.2 on f16 vs 96.8 on q8; falcon-mamba 107.8 on f16), so they stay on f16 rather than being opted in.
_options: Merged into a model-bearing request when the client omits the key; an explicit client value always wins. Matched by the same longest prefix as routes. Deliberately empty: num_parallel=1 alone took gemma4 from 28.1 to 62.9 tok/s, and halving num_ctx bought nothing further (62.9 at ctx 16384 vs 62.8 at 8192), so no per-model option is worth injecting. Injection is verified (longest prefix wins, client values survive, unknown models untouched) and stays as a hook for future models.
_defaults: Same merge and the same longest-prefix match as options, but for fields beside the options object rather than inside it. think is one: it is top-level in the ollama request, so options cannot reach it. The empty prefix matches every model.
_defaults_think: Off by default because the reasoning block and the answer share one num_predict budget, and reasoning wins. Measured on qwen3.6:35b-a3b at temperature 0: 94-99% of generated tokens went to reasoning across three prompts; 17*23 spent 280 tokens to return '391'; an LRU-cache prompt exhausted a 2048-token cap on reasoning alone and returned an empty answer (done_reason 'length'). Clients that want it send think:true and the merge leaves that untouched. think:false is accepted by completion-only models (verified against falcon-mamba), so the blanket prefix is safe for the four models here with no thinking capability.
_defaults_v1_quirk: ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint IGNORES the top-level think field for qwen3 thinking models: think:false still produces a long reasoning block that exhausts max_tokens and returns an empty answer (finish_reason 'length'). That same endpoint honors reasoning_effort instead, so both are injected: think:false covers native /api/chat, reasoning_effort:none covers /v1. Verified on qwen3.6:35b-a3b: v1+think:false -> 4786 reasoning chars + empty content; v1+reasoning_effort:none -> 0 reasoning chars, clean answer. Native /api/chat ignores unknown fields like reasoning_effort, so injecting it is safe there.
